## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the trigger, expected result and what changes for the user.

## Scope

Identify the affected core, migration, tooling or documentation boundary. Explain any public API, package, checker compatibility, filesystem or failure-semantics impact.

## Evidence

List commands actually run, their results, pre-existing failures and checks not run. Link a minimal reproduction when fixing an observable bug. Local results do not establish remote platform acceptance.

## Documentation

Update affected product documentation and complete English/Chinese PCR pairs when their contracts change. Explain any remaining uncertainty.
